role: Federal government led by Prime Minister Mark Carney
promise: Double Canada's preferential trade-market access over the next six months.
description: The Prime Minister's Office stated a six-month market-access target alongside the Canada Investment Summit. The due date is six calendar months after the announcement.
evidence: The official release states the target while describing existing trade agreements and prospective access from ASEAN to India; it does not demonstrate that the expansion has already happened.
